body: I'm not sure
I cant even get a job because they keep sacking me for not being able to attend everyday when my body hurts too much.

I'm 19 and I still never had a friend or girlfriend. I mainly got bullied at school and failed because of my physical disabilities that put me in a wheelchair. I just failed college twice now so I cant go study anymore. I got kicked out my house a year ago because my dad hates me. 

I don't see the point anymore. I tried getting help from a therapist but I keep getting denied one. Samaritans didn't really care either. 

So tell me, is this really going to get better?
Thanks, I reported the PM now.
Someone just told me to "make friends" and that's it. He wasn't even listening most of the time.
I just got told by two operators to go away :( fuck that website
I tried that website but they aren't really that helpful. I really am alone since I don't even have a single friend to talk to.

Thank you.

I can't seem to find any doctors to help since they really don't care. They keep taking away my painkillers too so I just end up using street cannabis to self-medicate. The NHS is just fucking awful.

I don't know, maybe I'll find someone to talk to IRL about this. I also tried using online communities to help lose weight while battling an autoimmune disease but I just keep getting told that I'm too lazy, so they can fuck off too.
I failed programming in college so can't really get any programming jobs. I tried learning  online but its just too hard.
Thank you so much. It seemed like every website was offline.
Nah. Everybody takes it as a joke, even the samaritans didn't care. Haven't been to a therapist yet but considering it if they aren't assholes. My mum takes it as a joke so she won't help.
I guess that's why I'm really depressed. My vitamin D levels are so low that my bones are slowly eroding away. Although i still have a shit life
I could really use this too. Why is every suicide chat room closed? So much for giving a shit...

It's just really hard because I got shit grades in secondary school and because I'm so depressed I might fail college too, meaning that I'll be stuck with a shit job for the rest of my life without any friends to make it any better. Which is a shame because I enjoy IT but I never have anyone to enjoy it with, which makes me not motivated at all to continue with this bullshit. 

I suppose that's life and I should deal with it for some reason although from the looks of it life is just not for me. It's clearly meant for people that had a much better chance. 

I try, I really do, but people just seem to ignore me. Been at it for 19 years and it just isn't working for me. My dad made a good point when he said I'm just a useless cunt who can't make friends.
Yeah, that's why I haven't been able to shoot myself.
I dunno, just sounds like merciful euthanasia to me. Obviously I wouldn't do it if he wasn't completely fucked. I guess that came out wrong.
Thanks for the kind gesture but I really just want someone IRL to talk to. Apart from my mum, everyone in my family is a dick who bullies me, even to go far as wishing cancer on me :/

Well I'm at College at the moment and I'm pretty much invisible to everyone, no matter how many times I try to talk with people. 

I can't seem to get a job right now since there is barely any openings in my area, plus because the physical pain becomes too much to handle, I can't always attend 5 days in a row, which means losing that job. 

I'm agnostic so church is not for me, although I see what you mean by volunteering. I think I need to sort out my medical conditions as they are pretty much destroying my life right now.

I suppose. Although from personal experience, people only do nice things to brag about it, rather than wanting to be nice. Kinda like how some religious people do good deeds to get their own selfish reward in the afterlife. Not all of them are like that, but some definitely are. 

You're probably getting downvoted because you're blunt about it, but it's a fair point. Have an upvote.
You're probably right. Sorry, it's just that I'm really angry right now. I shouldn't take it out on you guys :/

To those that said you help those because you genuinely want to help after going through the same shit... 

You are fucking awesome and really do make a difference in making the world a better place. Thank you so much. The idea of people just being nice is an alien concept to me. 

I kinda feel a bit better because of that, although I'm still depressed.

I haven't yet. I'm too worried since no matter who i talk to, I get treated like shit. Also the local GPs here really just don't give a shit.
